title: Kubo-Mori Liouvillian energy-gap window and tail decomposition
question: Does splitting the local Kubo-Mori fractional shell by doubled-bond transition energy isolate a finite low-gap component and diagnose whether the R-369 cutoff growth is carried by high-gap transitions?
promotion_boundary: R-370 is a finite exact decomposition of the R-369 local doubled-bond Kubo-Mori fractional proxy by transition-energy windows. It does not prove a cutoff-independent low-gap bound, a Gibbs-tail theorem, a common core, or any QFT closure.
next_action: Use the finite low/high split to formulate an analytic local Dirichlet collar: prove a cutoff-independent low-gap comparison and an independent Gibbs-tail estimate for the complement, then repeat the split on source-complete exhaustion families.
boundary: Finite actual-Q3 edge and square rows with all prefixes, translated bond terms, translated measured sites, orientations, signs, adjoints, beta values and declared transition-energy windows. Global KMS, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
